claims.claim_ar: الجذر: امن — المعنى: 'آمن/صدّق' (الإيمان، التصديق بالله وبما أخبر به)
claims.claim_en: Root 'امن' — meaning 'to believe / to have faith' (belief, affirmation of God and what He revealed).

claims.claim_ar: فعل ماضٍ تام بصيغة الغائب جمع مذكر سالم: علامة الجمع واو الجماعة (آمَنُوا = هم آمنوا).
الجذر: صلو — الكلمة: صَلَوٰة — المعنى: العبادة المفروضة (الصلاة).
claims.claim_en: Root 'صلو' — lemma 'صَلَوٰة' meaning the ritual prayer (ṣalāh).

claims.claim_ar: الجذر: كتم — المعنى العام: 'يخفي/يستُر'؛ صيغة المصدر الفعلية تدل على الإخفاء أو الإحجام عن الإظهار.
claims.claim_en: Root 'كتم' — general meaning 'to conceal, to hide'. (Source substring is a different inflected form: تَكْتُمُونَ.)
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited source substring is تَكْتُمُونَ (2nd plural imperfect) while the ayah's word is نَكْتُمُ (a different inflection); morphological mapping assumed but forms differ.

claims.claim_ar: الجذر (تَقليدياً): اله — الكلمة: لفظ الجلالة 'الله'، دلالة اسمية إلهية (الواحد المعبود).
claims.claim_en: Traditional root 'اله' (reconstruction) for the divine name 'Allah' — denotes God (the divine proper name).
claims.needs_review_reason: The 'root' of the divine proper name is a traditional/lexical reconstruction rather than a regular morphological derivation; treat as conventionally reported.

warnings: Only a subset of words in the provided ayah had matching or related substrings in the supplied source chunks. Claims were made for word indices: 3, 31, 33, 45.

Several ayah words (many pronouns, particles, and other nouns/verbs) lacked supporting substrings in the provided chunks; no morphological claims were extracted for them to avoid unsupported assertions.

Claim for word_index 45 (نَكْتُمُ) relies on the related substring تَكْتُمُونَ found in the sources; forms differ (imperfect 2nd plural vs. ayah form), so the mapping was inferred (see needs_review_reason).
The root reported for 'اللَّه' is a conventional/traditional reconstruction (اله) and is marked for caution.
